description: Add 4-6 deterministic AI-capability test scenarios to the Example app as an 'AI Test Lab' tab, plus the minimal, justified src/ fixes those scenarios and honest docs depend on (wire body-field redaction via config.redaction.fields; fix the stale SettingsTab version string). Also fix the pre-existing Example Jest failure so `npx jest` passes. Independent of FEAT-002 in code, but MUST run first because FEAT-002 docs describe the final scenarios and the final redaction behavior landed here.
steps: SRC FIX (redaction, decision D1b): In src/interceptors/NetworkInterceptor.ts, after capturing requestBody and responseBody, if config.redaction?.fields has entries, best-effort JSON.parse each body, apply redactFields(parsed, fields) from ../utils/redact, and re-stringify; on parse failure leave the already-truncated raw string untouched and never throw. When config.redaction is set but fields is omitted, default fields to ['password','token','secret','accessToken','refreshToken']. Leave header redaction (redactHeaders) unchanged. Export redactFields from src/index.ts for parity.

SRC FIX (version, decision D2/D6): bump package.json version to 0.2.1; update src/core/AppLens.ts getVersion() to return '0.2.1'; change src/tabs/SettingsTab.tsx footer to render AppLens.getVersion() (via `AppLens v${AppLens.getVersion()}`) instead of the hardcoded 'AppLens v0.1.0'. (If you choose the zero-src-risk path instead, keep 0.2.0, skip the redaction wiring, still fix the SettingsTab literal to 0.2.0, and record that choice so FEAT-002 docs stay consistent — but the recommended path is 0.2.1 with the redaction wiring.)

Create Example/src/aiLab/scenarios.ts exporting an array of scenario objects { id, title, description, suggestedQuestion, run(): Promise<void> }. Each run() generates deterministic runtime evidence using fetch + console.* + AppLens.trackEvent, wrapped in try/catch so offline still logs/tracks and never crashes. Keep generic (ShopDemo framing; NO Triveni Point). Scenarios: (1) Failed API: fetch https://httpbin.org/status/500 (fallback https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/doesnotexist for 404), on non-ok console.error + trackEvent('checkout_failed',{status}); Q 'Why did checkout fail?'. (2) Response shape mismatch: fetch https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1, read data.order.id (undefined), console.warn the undefined; Q 'The checkout API succeeds but the confirmation is empty. Why?'. (3) Runtime error/unhandled rejection: throw inside a setTimeout/promise to produce a captured error with stack, and also console.error it so evidence exists on non-Hermes; Q 'What caused the latest error and where in the code?'. (4) Slow request + warning burst: fetch https://httpbin.org/delay/3 with several console.warn around it; Q 'Which requests are slow and what was logged around them?'. (5) Event funnel: trackEvent cart_viewed -> checkout_started -> payment_failed with small delays; Q "Summarize the user's last session flow.". (6) Redaction check: fetch https://httpbin.org/post with headers Authorization 'Bearer sk-demo-SECRET-TOKEN-123' and JSON body { password:'hunter2', token:'tok_demo_SECRET' }; Q 'What auth token was sent?' — expected: AI reports Authorization is [REDACTED]; if body redaction was wired in step 1, body password/token are [REDACTED] too.

Create Example/src/screens/AILabScreen.tsx: a scrollable list of scenario cards (title, description, 'Run scenario' button with running/done state, the suggestedQuestion in a selectable row with a 'Copy question' button using `import { Clipboard } from 'react-native'` inside try/catch exactly like src/tabs/AITab.tsx, plus a hint to open the AppLens AI tab and paste). Handle run() errors gracefully. Match the existing Example screen StyleSheet conventions and keep it ESLint/Prettier clean.
Wire the new screen into Example/src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx: add a 4th bottom tab 'AI Lab' (icon e.g. the test-tube emoji) pointing at AILabScreen, and add it to RootTabParamList.

OPTIONAL scenario #7 (code correlation): run `cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens && node src/ai/index-project.js Example/src > Example/src/aiLab/knowledge-graph.json`, confirm it is a non-empty GraphNode[]; in Example/App.tsx import the manifest and call AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(manifest) after initialize(); add scenario #7 Q 'Which file makes the /carts request?'. Ensure resolveJsonModule is available in Example/tsconfig.json (add if missing). Skip this scenario cleanly if the indexer output is empty.

Fix Example Jest (decision D4): edit Example/jest.config.js to add transformIgnorePatterns allowlisting @react-native, react-native, @react-navigation, react-native-safe-area-context, react-native-screens, react-native-markdown-display (pattern: ['node_modules/(?!(@react-native|react-native|@react-navigation|react-native-safe-area-context|react-native-screens|react-native-markdown-display)/)']). If safe-area/screens still break, add Example/jest.setup.js mocking them and reference via setupFiles. Keep __tests__/App.test.tsx passing; optionally add Example/__tests__/AILab.test.tsx rendering AILabScreen (mock navigation if needed) as a smoke test.

Record in findings exactly which path was taken (0.2.1 + redaction wiring vs 0.2.0 docs-only), the final scenario count/titles/questions, the redaction behavior for scenario #6 (header-only vs header+body), and whether scenario #7 was included — FEAT-002 needs these to write accurate docs.
acceptance_criteria: `cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/Example && npx jest` passes all suites (the pre-existing transformIgnorePatterns failure is fixed).
`npx eslint` on every changed/created Example file is clean.
The Example has an 'AI Lab' tab with 6 (or 7) scenario cards; each card runs without crashing offline and offers a tap-to-copy suggested question; no prefilled-prompt API was added to src/.

If the redaction path was taken: a request body with password/token is stored as [REDACTED] when config.redaction.fields is set, and Authorization header is [REDACTED] by default; redactFields is exported from src/index.ts.
All version strings (package.json, getVersion(), SettingsTab footer) agree with the chosen version.
No 'Triveni' string appears in any created/changed Example file.
verification: cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens/Example && npx eslint src/aiLab src/screens/AILabScreen.tsx src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx App.tsx
findings:
PATH TAKEN: 0.2.1 + redaction wiring (decision D1b/D2/D6, the recommended path). NOT the docs-only 0.2.0 path.

SRC CHANGES (library):
- src/interceptors/NetworkInterceptor.ts: added DEFAULT_REDACTED_FIELDS = ['password','token','secret','accessToken','refreshToken'] and a redactBody() helper. redactBody() is applied to request AND response bodies in BOTH the XHR and fetch paths, AFTER truncateBody(). It only acts when config.redaction is set; it best-effort JSON.parse()es the body, applies redactFields(parsed, fields) (fields = config.redaction.fields when non-empty, else DEFAULT_REDACTED_FIELDS), and re-stringifies. Non-JSON / parse-failure bodies are returned untouched; never throws. Header redaction (redactHeaders) is unchanged.
- src/index.ts: now exports { redactHeaders, redactFields } from './utils/redact'.
- src/core/AppLens.ts getVersion() -> '0.2.1'.
- package.json version -> '0.2.1'.
- src/tabs/SettingsTab.tsx footer now renders `AppLens v${AppLens.getVersion()}` (was hardcoded 'AppLens v0.1.0'). All three version strings agree at 0.2.1.

VERSION STRINGS CONSISTENT: package.json=0.2.1, getVersion()=0.2.1, SettingsTab footer=getVersion() (0.2.1).

EXAMPLE CHANGES:
- Example/App.tsx: added config.redaction.fields = ['password','token','secret','accessToken','refreshToken'] so body redaction is active in the Example; imported ./src/aiLab/knowledge-graph.json and call AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(knowledgeGraph as GraphNode[]) after initialize() (GraphNode imported from @applens/react-native). resolveJsonModule was already enabled via @react-native/typescript-config base — no Example tsconfig change needed.
- Example/src/aiLab/scenarios.ts: 7 scenarios (array `scenarios`).
- Example/src/screens/AILabScreen.tsx: scrollable scenario-card list, light theme matching other Example screens, Run button with idle/running/done/error state, suggested question in a selectable row with a 'Copy question' button using `import { Clipboard } from 'react-native'` inside try/catch (same pattern as src/tabs/AITab.tsx). NO prefilled-prompt API added to src/ (tap-to-copy only, decision D3).
- Example/src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx: added 4th bottom tab 'AI Lab' (icon 🧪) -> AILabScreen, added 'AI Lab' to RootTabParamList.
- Example/src/aiLab/knowledge-graph.json: generated GraphNode[] (10 nodes) via `npx tsc src/ai/CodeIndexer.ts` transpile then indexProject('Example/src') — ts-node is NOT installed so index-project.js's ts-node fallback does not work; I transpiled CodeIndexer.ts with the already-present tsc into a temp dir and ran it. Nodes include CartScreen (screens/CartScreen.tsx) which is the file that issues the POST /carts request. Non-empty, verified.
- Example/jest.config.js: added transformIgnorePatterns allowlisting @react-native|react-native|@react-navigation|react-native-safe-area-context|react-native-screens|react-native-markdown-display, and setupFiles = [preset's @react-native/jest-preset/jest/setup.js (preserved via require.resolve), '<rootDir>/jest.setup.js'].
- Example/jest.setup.js: NEW. Defines inert global.XMLHttpRequest and global.fetch when absent. Needed because App.tsx calls AppLens.initialize() at module load, which attaches NetworkInterceptor and dereferences XMLHttpRequest.prototype — undefined in the Node test env. This was a SECOND pre-existing jest blocker surfaced only after the transformIgnorePatterns fix (the plan's D4 anticipated adding a setup-file mock if needed). No library code was changed for this.
- Example/__tests__/AILab.test.tsx: NEW smoke test rendering AILabScreen and asserting it contains 'AI Test Lab'.

FINAL SCENARIO COUNT: 7 (6 core + optional #7 code-correlation, which SHIPPED). Titles and EXACT suggested questions:
  1 '1 · Failed checkout request' -> 'Why did checkout fail?'
  2 '2 · Response shape mismatch' -> 'The checkout API succeeds but the confirmation is empty. Why?'
  3 '3 · Runtime error' -> 'What caused the latest error and where in the code?'
  4 '4 · Slow request + warnings' -> 'Which requests are slow and what was logged around them?'
  5 '5 · Session event funnel' -> "Summarize the user's last session flow."
  6 '6 · Secret redaction' -> 'What auth token was sent?'
  7 '7 · Code correlation' -> 'Which file makes the /carts request?'

SCENARIO #6 REDACTION BEHAVIOR: HEADER + BODY. The Authorization header value ('Bearer sk-demo-SECRET-TOKEN-123') is redacted to [REDACTED] by default (redactHeaders). Because body-field redaction was wired (step 1) AND the Example sets config.redaction.fields, the request body's `password` ('hunter2') and `token` ('tok_demo_SECRET') are also stored as [REDACTED] (the `note` field is preserved). Verified redactFields output: {"password":"[REDACTED]","token":"[REDACTED]","note":"keep"}. So the AI cannot reveal the header or body secret. FEAT-002 docs should describe redaction as header+body (body redaction active when config.redaction is set), newly wired in 0.2.1, no longer 'Planned/header-only'.

SCENARIO #7 SHIPPED: YES. Example loads the knowledge-graph.json manifest; the AI can correlate the /carts runtime request to CartScreen via the graph summary.
